Definition: an Elonite or descendant (collectively) of Elon
BiblicalUsage: In the Old Testament, ʼÊlôwnîy is the word for an Elonite or descendant (collectively) of Elon. In Numbers 26:26, the text says "of Elon."
TheologicalSignificance: I take ʼêlôwnîy as it stands: an Elonite or descendant of Elon.
